meaning: A nested level of the Milky Way's star dots around the Sun, out to 20 pc: the dots it adds to the levels around it bring it to its own even density, so zooming in never empties the view.
maxKinematicSigmaBasis: Presentation choice, not a paper value: a kinematic distance whose ±7 km/s uncertainty exceeds 1 kpc is left out. Those are the sources toward tangent points, the Galactic centre and the anticentre, which pile onto a circle through the Sun and the centre; 1 kpc drops 917 of the 7,589 tracers inside the frame and three quarters of the ones on that circle. Hou & Han (2014) weight a kinematic distance down from 0.5 kpc of uncertainty.
colourTowardWhiteBasis: Presentation choice: each catalogue colour mixed halfway to white before the gamma, because the saturated colours read as neon over the backing. The hue order of every catalogue is kept.
colourGammaBasis: Presentation choice, picked from three renders over the backing (full opacity, 65% opacity, gamma 1.6): each colour channel raised to the power 1.6, so the coloured dots sink into the painted arms and the whitest keep their sparkle.
basis: Every star of the Gaia Catalogue of Nearby Stars within 20 pc not already drawn by an outer level, unthinned: inside the galaxy the census is drawn as measured, so its real clumps and gaps show. The census's own 20 pc reach is the level's edge.
